modalities.evidence: 64 EEG channels and 4 auxiliary oculogram channels

output.population: 69 healthy women, age range 19-40 years, acquired at the Department of Psychology, University of Oslo
output.summary: EEG from healthy women in a single session with two paradigms: resting-state (eyes-open and eyes-closed) and loudness dependence of auditory evoked potentials, studying hormonal contraceptive use and serotonergic activity. Questionnaire and cycle data included.
